controlledCacheHitMiss.reason: Uncontrolled single-probe Preview requests cannot isolate cache hits from misses.

naturalCacheHitRatio.reason: Natural hit ratio requires replaying an identical request sequence over the 60 s TTL window.
naturalCacheHitRatio.requiredProtocol: Matched request replay with <= 2 percentage point cache-hit loss.

previewOutageRecovery.reason: Outage recovery requires a controlled failure of live backend reads after the 60 s cache entry expires.
previewOutageRecovery.requiredProtocol: Verify warm last-good fallback, 30 s retry backoff, cold retriable error, archive 404, and reactivation refresh.
previewOutageRecovery.ownedBy: Separate room performance & cache report + tests/unit/villa-server.test.ts

browserBundleAndTourPerf.reason: Client bundle budgets and mobile 360 tour drag-to-frame latency are measured by browser/manifest benchmarks.
